name: 115.简

basedOn.note: Test21 current-folder search and carried recent-play path have not yet received an explicit device result. Test22 leaves those pages untouched and isolates the next planned slice to offline save-target selection plus Offline Center Phase3.

features: add an independent offline save-directory picker with root/up navigation and create-folder support
allow setting any selected 115 folder as the default offline destination, with one-tap reset to automatic selection
custom destination takes priority over the existing automatic 海阔视界 -> 云下载/离线下载 -> root fallback chain
Account Center V2 exposes the current offline destination and opens the destination picker directly
Offline Center V4 adds a compact 改目录 entry and shows whether the current target is custom or automatic
preserve Phase2 progress/speed/remaining-time/task-time display and conservative single-video direct-play behavior
surface common failure text when the normalized offline task provides one
show per-page task counts for active/completed/failed and keep manual refresh only
failed-task resubmit uses the selected custom target when configured

safety.syntaxGuard: offline_target_picker_v1.js, account_center_v2.js, offline_center_v4.js and installer.js passed node --check; installer also parses all three replacement modules with new Function before saving

validationTarget: Test21 File Management/current-folder search/recent-play behavior does not regress
离线中心 改目录 opens the folder picker and navigation works
selecting a folder changes the displayed save directory to 自定义
a newly submitted offline task uses the selected custom directory
恢复自动 returns destination behavior to the existing automatic priority chain
Account Center shows the same selected destination and can reopen the picker
completed tasks still use the Phase2 direct-play/result fallback behavior
